title: Memory-only domains follow actual account authority
description: Use real private sources, account form and admin-to-operator downgrade. Inspect canonical memory and rendered projections, then new source on recovery. No provider or browser command.

proofTargets.claim: A real account switch clears the old owner projection before current authorized domain data is shown.
An admin-to-operator downgrade keeps farm access and clears forbidden canonical and rendered domain facts.
Restored admin authority reads and renders a real source change committed while access was absent.
The disposable credential, principal and profile are retired and the original account is restored unchanged.

prove.intent: Switch accounts, remove admin and recover the selected domain view.

domainPrincipalClears.intent: Clear the old owner domain projection through the actual account switch.

domainRoleClears.intent: Keep farm access while clearing forbidden canonical and visible facts.

domainRecoveryReadsNewSource.intent: Read the changed owning source after admin authority returns.

originalAccountRestored.intent: Restore the original account and retire the disposable identity.

domain.description: Existing domain to prove on the isolated private stack.
